update_policy: Review canonical changes, copy verbatim and refresh hashes together.

backend_response_integrity_review.scope: Complete HTTP response framing, uncertain write outcome recovery, and malformed apply-result rejection; no automatic mutation retry.
backend_response_integrity_review.acceptance: Source correction only; current CI and installed-target qualification remain required.

recovery_identity_review.scope: Bind read and apply receipts to the requested plan and exact configured target, validate recognized states, preserve uncertain effects without replay.
recovery_identity_review.qualification: Local source contracts only; current-revision CI and installed backend qualification remain required.
